name: 07044 · Verona, NJ
findings: ZIP 07044 (Verona) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07044 (Verona) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07044 (Verona) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
